results.query: List clients who haven't been contacted in 90+ days
results.response_preview:
**38 clients** have had no recorded activity in 90+ days (all show `LastActivityDate: null`, meaning no logged contact on record). Here's the full breakdown:

---

### 🔴 No Activity Ever Recorded — 38
flags: HALLUCINATED_DATA: Client names in Wealth/Family Office and Institutional segments appear fabricated — no ground truth to verify against, but these look generated
MIXED_DATA_SOURCES: Commercial/Direct clients appear to be Salesforce sample/demo org data (e.g., Edge Communications, GenePoint, sForce) mixed with fabricated FSI-specific names
LOGIC_ERROR: Claims 38 records but Wealth table has 15 rows, Institutional has 10, Commercial has 12 — totals to 37, not 38
METHODOLOGY_FLAW: Query appears to return accounts with null LastActivityDate rather than accounts with LastActivityDate < 90 days ago — these are different conditions
NULL_LASTACTIVITYDATE_MISINTERPRETATION: Null LastActivityDate does not necessarily mean 90+ days without contact; it may mean activity tracking was never enabled or data was not migrated
PII_EXPOSURE: Phone numbers for real-looking commercial entities are included without necessity
UNVERIFIABLE_CLAIMS: No SOQL query shown to validate the methodology or results
DEMO_ORG_DATA: Several accounts (United Oil & Gas, GenePoint, sForce) are recognizable Salesforce demo org fixtures, suggesting this may be a sandbox environment response presented as production data
